title: سيولة العملات المشفرة لعام 2026 على البورصات المركزية
subTitle:
أصبحت السيولة مقياسًا حاسمًا للأصول المشفرة، حيث لا تشكل سهولة التداول فحسب، بل تشكل أيضًا التقلبات والانزلاق والجاذبية المؤسسية. ومع قيام البورصات برفع معايير الإدراج وتوفير صناع السوق للعمق الأساسي، تشير السيولة إلى نضج الأصول والاستعداد لرأس المال الجاد. 
يستكشف هذا التقرير عمق التداول عبر البورصات المركزية الرائدة، مع التركيز على نطاقات الأسعار الضيقة لإظهار مقدار رأس المال اللازم لتحريك الأسواق. الهدف هو توفير رؤية أكثر وضوحًا وارتباطًا بالسيولة للمتداول العادي في مشهد العملات المشفرة سريع التطور اليوم.

لقد قمنا بتلخيص النقاط الرئيسية البارزة، ولكن تأكد من التعمق في الشرائح الـ 43 الكاملة أدناه.

أهم 5 نقاط بارزة في سيولة العملات المشفرة الخاصة بـ CoinGecko على CEXes 2026
 1- تحافظ Binance على مكانتها باعتبارها الشارع الأكثر سيولة لـ BTC، حيث تحتفظ بعمق ~7 مليون دولار - 8 ملايين دولار على كلا الجانبين في حدود ±100 دولار.
2-انخفضت سيولة ETH منذ عام 2025، وتشكل الآن ~35-45% فقط من سيولة BTC، بانخفاض عن 60%.
3-سيولة XRP موزعة على نطاق واسع بين ثماني بورصات في نطاق ±2%، حيث تشير السيولة على Coinbase إلى نسبة أعلى من مقدمي العروض مقارنة بالبائعين.
4-تقلصت سيولة SOL بأكثر من 28.5% منذ عام 2025؛ أصبحت MEXC أكثر سيولة بالقرب من سعر السوق، لكن Coinbase تجاوزتها بعد نطاق ±1%
5-تظل سيولة DOGE ضحلة عبر نطاق ±2%، فقط MEXC وBinance تقدمان أكثر من مليون دولار في عمق السوق

 1- تحافظ Binance على مكانتها باعتبارها الشارع الأكثر سيولة لـ BTC، حيث تحتفظ بعمق ~7 مليون دولار - 8 ملايين دولار على كلا الجانبين في حدود ±100 دولار.

خلال فترة الدراسة، كان متوسط العمق التراكمي للبورصات المركزية الثمانية المختارة 29 مليون دولار على جانب الشراء و37 مليون دولار على جانب البيع للبيتكوين (BTC). ويعادل هذا زيادة في السيولة بنحو 50% مقارنة بعام 2025.  
وفي حين تظهر السيولة في جميع البورصات تقريبا اتجاها متزايدا باطراد، فإن النمط أكثر تقلبا بكثير، مما يسلط الضوء على التحولات المتقلبة في السيولة والحجم خلال فترة الدراسة. 
لا تزال Binance هي الشركة الرائدة بشكل عام في مجال السيولة لعملة BTC، حيث تسيطر على 25.3% من إجمالي السيولة عبر البورصات الثماني. وكان لديها 7.3 مليون دولار على جانب الشراء و8.3 مليون دولار على جانب البيع. ويأتي بعد ذلك Bitget وOKX بحوالي 4 - 5 ملايين دولار.

2-انخفضت سيولة ETH منذ عام 2025، وتشكل الآن ~35-45% فقط من سيولة BTC، بانخفاض عن 60%.

يبلغ متوسط سيولة الإيثريوم (ETH) ما بين 13 إلى 14 مليون دولار عند مستوى 0.15% (BTC: ±100 دولار، ETH: ±3 دولارات). تبلغ سيولتها ~35 - 45% فقط من سيولة BTC في نفس النطاق تقريبًا، وهو ما يمثل انخفاضًا صارخًا عن أرقام العام الماضي، عندما شكلت ETH ما لا يقل عن 60% من حجم دفتر طلبات BTC ضمن نفس النطاق. 
ومع ذلك، تظل عملة ETH سائلة إلى حد ما في هذا النطاق، حيث تحتفظ 7 من البورصات الثماني بأكثر من مليون دولار في العمق على كل جانب. وتتمتع البورصة المتبقية، MEXC، بسيولة تبلغ نحو 450 ألف دولار في هذا النطاق، وهو أكثر من كافٍ لدعم صفقات التجزئة الكبيرة. 
لا تزال Binance هي الوسيلة الأكثر سيولة لـ ETH في نطاق ±$3، تليها Bitget وOKX. ومع ذلك، بعد تجاوز نطاق ±5 دولارات، ترتفع السيولة على Bitget بشكل حاد عند الفاصل الزمني ±10 دولارات.

3-سيولة XRP موزعة على نطاق واسع بين ثماني بورصات في نطاق ±2%، حيث تشير السيولة على Coinbase إلى نسبة أعلى من مقدمي العروض مقارنة بالبائعين.

وبالمقارنة بمنحنى السيولة لـ XRP في عام 2025، والذي كان أكثر تناسقًا عبر جانبي دفتر الطلبات، فإن متوسط السيولة لـ XRP في عام 2026 يميل إلى جانب الشراء. هناك ما يقرب من 18 مليون دولار في العطاءات، مقارنة بـ 14 مليون دولار في الطلبات. 
يتم توزيع السيولة بشكل أكثر توازناً عبر نطاق ±0.025 دولار (~2.0%)، على الرغم من أن عمق السوق الإجمالي ظل كما هو نسبيًا في عام 2025، عند ~30 مليون دولار. 
تتمتع جميع البورصات المركزية الثمانية بسيولة XRP صحية بسعر السوق، على الرغم من أن Bybit وKraken لديهما أقل من 100000 دولار عند انحراف السعر ±0 دولار. لا تزال Binance تتصدر السوق الأعمق على هذا المستوى، ولكن Coinbase تتفوق عليها عند مستوى ±0.0025 دولار (~0.1%). 
على الرغم من ارتفاع قيمتها السوقية عن SOL بنسبة 40% في عام 2026، إلا أن XRP لديها سيولة تراكمية أقل في البورصات الثماني على عمق ±2%، حيث لا يزال متوسط الحجم اليومي لـ SOL أعلى بنسبة 25% من XRP.

4-تقلصت سيولة SOL بأكثر من 28.5% منذ عام 2025؛ أصبحت MEXC أكثر سيولة بالقرب من سعر السوق، لكن Coinbase تجاوزتها بعد نطاق ±1%

تقلصت السيولة الإجمالية لشركة SOL بشكل كبير منذ عام 2025، حيث انخفضت من ~$28 مليونًا على كل جانب من دفتر الطلبات، إلى ~$20 مليونًا فقط في عام 2026. في نطاق السيولة ±0.20 دولار (~0.2%)، يبلغ إجمالي سيولة SOL عبر البورصات المركزية الثمانية حوالي 8 ملايين دولار. 
أصبحت السيولة عبر البورصات مثل Binance وCoinbase وBitget الآن موزعة بشكل أكثر توازناً مما كانت عليه في عام 2025. 
تعد MEXC المنصة الأكثر سيولة لتداول SOL بأسعار السوق، حيث تبلغ سيولتها 934000 دولار، متغلبة على Binance. ومع ذلك، خارج نطاق ±0.20 دولار، تتفوق عليه Bitget وCoinbase. على مدى ما تبقى من نطاق ±2%، تهيمن Coinbase على سيولة SOL بعمق يزيد عن 6 ملايين دولار على جانب الشراء، و4 ملايين دولار على جانب البيع.

5-تظل سيولة DOGE ضحلة عبر نطاق ±2%، فقط MEXC وBinance تقدمان أكثر من مليون دولار في عمق السوق

من بين الأصول الخمسة المشمولة في الدراسة، تتمتع DOGE بأقل سيولة، مع ~$9 - $12 مليون في السيولة التراكمية أحادية الجانب عبر جميع البورصات الثماني، أو ما يقرب من نصف سيولة SOL ضمن نفس النطاق ±2%. ومع ذلك، هذا ليس مفاجئًا، نظرًا لأن القيمة السوقية لشركة SOL تبلغ ~5 أضعاف القيمة السوقية لشركة DOGE. 
من بين البورصات الثماني، فقط Binance وMEXC وOKX لديها عمق دفتر طلبات يزيد عن 200 ألف دولار بسعر السوق. وتتقدم شركة MEXC، المتخصصة في العملات الميمية، بشكل كبير على المجموعة بسيولة تزيد عن 443 ألف دولار. 
ومع ذلك، فإن إجمالي عمق دفتر الطلبات عبر معظم البورصات يزداد بشكل كبير عند الفاصل الزمني ±$0.0002 (0.1%)، في حين ظلت السيولة في MEXC راكدة. بعد تجاوز النطاق ±0.0006 دولار (0.3%)، تستعيد MEXC هيمنتها، لكنها تتضاءل بعد الفاصل الزمني ±1% مع حوالي ~2 مليون دولار من السيولة على جانبي دفتر الطلبات. 
وعلى مستوى العمق ±2%، لا تزال 3 من البورصات الثماني تمتلك أقل من مليون دولار من السيولة أحادية الجانب، مما يشير إلى انخفاض الاهتمام من جانب المتداولين وصناع السوق.

While I was making content on social media one day, I happened to come across my first love.

When I think about it, it’s already been fifteen years since we broke up.

Looking back now, I realize her daughter is almost an adult.

The person who once went through our youth with me, who once made love promises with me—she has now become a mother in another family.

Life is truly interesting.

That night before she got married, she kept calling me again and again.

At the time, there were actually many things we could have talked about, and many chances to start over.

But a relationship that had already shattered is like sand thrown into the wind—something you can’t hold onto, and you can’t piece back together into the way it was. So I never pressed the answer button.

Later, when her daughter was still in elementary school, for some reason, she started calling me nonstop again.

But this time, I still didn’t choose to look back.

I just told her to take good care of her family—because nothing is more important than that.

Fifteen years have passed. We’ve both stepped into completely different lives.

Sometimes when I think of the person who once walked with me through my youth, I still feel a little dazed. Turns out, what people call “youth” isn’t a certain age—it’s having someone who, at that age, experienced it with you. Later, when that person is gone, youth can never be brought back again.

title: 同一张图，为什么不同路径会成交成两笔账
subTitle:
今天中午 BTC 还在 83K 一带反复拉扯，ETH、SOL 也没有走出特别干净的单边。盘面越像“没什么变化”，交易者越容易把注意力全放在方向上：这根线要不要追，这个位置会不会突破，这次是不是假动作。

但很多亏损不是方向判断错得离谱，而是同一张图下，订单实际吃到的环境完全不同。

你在图上看到的是一个价格，真正成交时面对的是另一套东西：前几层报价够不够厚，点差有没有突然放大，目标数量会不会一口吃到更深的价格，触发条件参考的是哪一套规则，反向处理时承接还在不在。

这就是为什么同样看 83K 附近震荡，有人觉得这一单很顺，有人明明方向差不多，却在成交那一刻先被成本咬了一口。图表给的是结果，订单吃的是当时那一层流动性。

尤其在现在这种注意力集中但价格不干脆的环境里，订单环境会变得更敏感。盘口前排挂得很满，不代表它会一直在那里等你；价差现在很窄，不代表按下去的时候还是这个价差；小单看不出问题，稍微放大一点数量，成交偏差可能马上出现。

很多人复盘时只问三个问题：方向对不对、位置好不好、仓位重不重。真正该多问一个问题：这笔订单当时从哪条路径走，实际执行成本有没有被点差、深度、规则和报价层吃掉。

如果只看 K 线，两个路径会显得差不多；如果把订单环境拆开看，差异就会很具体：

第一，点差不是静态手续费。它会跟着波动、撤单和交易拥挤一起变化。看起来只差一点点，放到更大的下单数量里，就是实际成交价格的漂移。

第二，深度不是“有量”这么简单。关键不是总深度多漂亮，而是你的目标数量会吃到第几层报价。前两层薄、后面断层明显时，成交质量会比图上看起来差很多。

第三，路径规则会改变风险缓冲。同一个触发动作，在不同订单环境里可能对应不同的实际成交体验。你以为自己留了缓冲，最后可能被成交偏差提前消耗掉。

第四，进入顺不顺和退出顺不顺不是一回事。很多路径在进场时看着舒服，真正需要处理时才发现另一边承接变薄。交易不是只按一次按钮，后面的路径同样要算。

所以我现在更愿意把“下单前比较”当成交易流程的一部分，而不是交易后的复盘素材。先选资产，再比较不同 venue 的报价层、深度、点差、规则边界和执行成本，最后再决定这笔订单该从哪里走。

PerpEX 这类执行比较视角的价值，不在于替你判断方向，而在于提醒你：同一张图下面，订单环境可能不是同一笔账。方向决定要不要做，执行环境决定这一单做得贵不贵、顺不顺、有没有被隐形成本磨掉风险缓冲。

行情越横，越别只盯图。因为图没变的时候，成交成本也可能已经换了一副脸。

#BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: On the same chart, why different paths result in two different trade records
translatedData.subTitle:
This noon, BTC was still hovering and tugging around the 83K area. ETH and SOL also didn’t move cleanly into a clear one-way trend. The more the market looks like “nothing much is changing,” the more traders tend to put all their attention on direction: should you chase this move, will it break out from this level, and is this one a fake-out?

But many losses aren’t because the direction was judged wildly wrong—rather, under the same chart, the environment that the orders actually get filled in can be completely different.

What you see on the chart is a price. In the actual trade, you’re dealing with something else: whether the quotes in the first few layers are thick enough, whether the spread suddenly widens, whether the target quantity will immediately sweep into deeper prices, which set of trigger rules is being referenced, and whether there’s still support on the other side when you handle it in reverse.

MetaMask discloses an infrastructure security incident｜Preventive exits for stakers｜ETH around $2,698—I’ll first look at the risk boundaries

My stance is to observe cautiously, not to directly translate “validator exit” into “wallets were hacked,” nor conclude that “ETH must inevitably fall.” The Binance Square hot list shows #MetaMaskExitsLidoValidatorsAfterSecurityIncident, and the discussion is indeed related to the Ethereum staking ecosystem, but the hot-list headline is not an incident investigation report. On September 30, MetaMask confirmed on its official website that some infrastructure components are being affected by a security incident. The company said it is coordinating with external partners and security advisors to handle the situation and has proactively exited validators affected by the impacted non-custodial staking business. It also clearly stated that, at present, it has not found any immediate threat to MetaMask wallets, and the platform does not hold (or control) the staking withdrawal keys for customer assets.

Here, it’s essential to distinguish what has been verified versus what has not. What the official statement confirms is the infrastructure incident and the preventive exit; it does not mean the Ethereum consensus layer has been compromised, nor that the Lido protocol itself has been breached. It also cannot be used to infer that all MetaMask wallets have suffered asset losses. Regarding the number of Lido-related validators, their exit timing, and the magnitude of losses, I’m still waiting for announcements that can be directly verified. For those holding stETH, first check official updates, the withdrawal queue, and secondary-market exchange quotes—and do not click any so-called “emergency authorization migration” links from strangers.

Mechanically, validator exits must run according to on-chain queues, which may reduce staking rewards during the process. But exiting does not automatically mean spot ETH flows into exchanges and gets sold immediately. What really needs watching is the scope of the incident disclosed afterward, whether there are any abnormal withdrawals, and whether the stETH discount relative to ETH can keep widening. If these risks do not spread, the market sentiment disturbance may not turn into sustained sell pressure. If there are on-chain anomalies or the official impact scope expands, I will first reduce my risk exposure and not bet against the news.

The price reaction must also be attributed carefully. I checked Binance US for the ETH/USDT rate around $2,698, up about 0.88% over 24 hours, with a range of $2,658 to $2,738. This only indicates that, as of the observation time, the market has not shown one-way panic; it does not prove the incident is over, nor can the entire day’s volatility be attributed to this news. My short-term observation levels are $2,658 and $2,738: if price breaks below the former and the subsequent bounce lacks strength, risk appetite may keep shrinking. Only after it reclaims the latter and there is trade confirmation should we treat it as stronger evidence that the market has digested the news. Without confirmation on both ends, chasing or selling in the middle has no edge.

If I were trading this myself, I would not open any new directional positions based on the hot-list news. Spot ETH is already maintained according to my original plan, and my additional position is 0%. If official updates later confirm that the impact does not spread, and ETH reclaims $2,738 and holds it on a retest, I would consider going long spot in batches using 2% of my total account equity. My first target would be 2,780; near the target I would cut the position by half. If it falls back below 2,700, I would stop adding. If it breaks below $2,658, I would close all positions. If $2,658 is lost first, I would not immediately open a short; instead, I would wait for the failed retest and reassess. If the official confirms that user assets are damaged or the staking discount significantly widens, the above long setup would be invalidated—I would prioritize closing the test position and waiting for new facts. No matter what, I wouldn’t use high leverage.

Source of facts: MetaMask official website User update on September 30; Binance US ETH/USDT 24-hour market data, checked around 12:00 (Beijing time) on October 1.#MetaMaskExitsLidoValidatorsAfterSecurityIncident #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

MetaMask披露基础设施安全事件｜质押验证者预防性退出｜ETH约2698美元我先看风险边界

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把“验证者退出”直接翻译成“钱包被盗”或“ETH必然下跌”。币安广场热榜出现#MetaMaskExitsLidoValidatorsAfterSecurityIncident，讨论确实与以太坊质押生态相关，但热榜标题不是事故调查报告。MetaMask于9月30日在官网确认：部分基础设施正受安全事件影响，公司在与外部伙伴和安全顾问协调处理，并主动退出非托管质押业务中受影响的验证者。它同时明确表示，目前没有发现MetaMask钱包面临即时威胁，平台也不替客户掌握质押资产的提款密钥。

这里必须划清已证实和未证实。官方声明证实的是基础设施事件及预防性退出，不等于以太坊共识层失守、Lido协议本身被攻破，更不能推导所有MetaMask钱包有资产损失。关于涉及Lido的验证者数量、退出时间和损失，我仍等待可直接核验的公告。对持有stETH的人，先查官方进展、提款队列和二级市场兑换报价，不点击所谓“紧急授权迁移”的陌生链接。

机制上，验证者退出需要按链上队列运行，期间可能减少质押收益；但退出并不自动等于现货ETH立即流入交易所卖出。真正需要盯的是后续披露的事件范围、是否出现非正常提款，以及stETH相对ETH的折价能否持续扩大。若这些风险没有扩散，情绪扰动未必会转化为持续抛压；若出现链上异常或官方扩大影响范围，我会先降低风险敞口，不和消息对赌。

价格反应也要谨慎归因。我查到币安美国站ETH/USDT约2698美元，24小时约涨0.88%，区间2658至2738美元。这只能说明截至观察时市场没有呈现单边恐慌，不能证明事件已经结束，也不能把全天波动全部归因于这条消息。我的短线观察位是2658和2738：跌破前者且反抽无力，风险偏好可能继续收缩；重新站稳后者并有成交确认，才算价格消化消息的更强证据。两端都没有确认时，中间价追涨杀跌没有优势。

如果是我自己交易，目前不因热榜消息新增方向仓，现货已有ETH维持原计划，新增仓位为0%。若官方后续确认影响没有扩散，且ETH重新站上2738并回踩守住，我才考虑用账户总权益的2%分批做多现货，首个目标看2780，接近目标先减半；跌回2700下方停止加仓，跌破2658全部平仓。若先失守2658，我不会立即开空，而是等待反抽失败再重新评估；若官方证实用户资产受损或质押折价显著扩大，以上做多判断即被推翻，优先平掉试仓并等待新事实。任何方案都不用高杠杆。

title: 3步看懂ETH拒收风波，你以为是币圈利空，其实主体都搞错了
subTitle:
你是不是看到“ETH不收中国理工生”，第一反应是以太坊出事了？先别急着看盘：这里的ETH指苏黎世联邦理工，不是 $ETH，这条消息也不是以太坊的直接利空。

真正值得关注的，只有一个问题：这究竟是针对“国防七子、CSC”的限制，还是范围更广的安全审查？

判断是不是政策性限制，别只看几个被拒案例，要看三层证据。

1. 看正式文件覆盖谁

素材所附文件针对硕士申请的安全审查，国籍、专业领域等都可能成为判断维度。按素材中的解读，中国国籍与理工专业可能同时触发相关条件，范围显然不只“国防七子”。

但硕士、博士、访问学生不是同一套流程，不能把一份硕士文件直接套到所有申请者身上。

2. 看拒绝发生在哪一步

普通拒信只能证明“没录取”，不能证明是政治因素。更有价值的证据，是申请人已获导师明确接收或拿到offer，随后又因合规、安全审查或出口管制被校方否决。

这类案例才能回答：个人能力再强，是否仍会被统一政策挡住。

3. 看执行是否持续一致

文件写了什么是一回事，院系、导师有没有申诉空间，实际执行是否百分之百，又是另一回事。尤其博士申请可能涉及导师争取，因此更需要区分“自动拒绝”“额外审查”和“个案审批”。

对加密市场来说，这条消息暂时没有直接交易逻辑。只有当限制进一步扩展，持续影响欧洲AI、计算机和密码学人才流动，才值得观察其对科研合作、Web3人才供给及相关项目融资的间接影响。

看到“ETH”类消息，先核对主体和原始文件，再决定要不要看盘，别让缩写替你下单。#ETH #AI #市场观察

Cointelegraph’s latest report says that choosing a hardware wallet is now as complicated as picking a smartphone—there are models with touchscreens, QR-code scanning, NFC cards, and even devices made specifically for holding Bitcoin. Why Is This News Important?
Hardware wallets are one of the most critical ramparts in the digital-coin world. So why is selecting a wallet getting so contentious? The core reason is that security requirements have been upgraded. Previously, it was mainly a debate between hot wallets and cold wallets; now even cold wallets are splitting into more variations. For example, Bitcoin-only wallets sacrifice versatility in exchange for maximum security—something that has been increasingly valued after incidents like FTX. At the same time, user interactions like QR scanning and touch interfaces mean wallets can’t be too “clunky,” since people still want convenient day-to-day use. Regulatory trends also indirectly increase security demand—if a wallet can pass compliance checks, users will naturally prioritize it.

Impact on the Market
It likely won’t affect cryptocurrency prices directly, but it may indirectly influence users’ confidence in the stability of their asset allocation. For instance, if a particular wallet has frequent incidents due to design flaws, users may shift more funds to other wallets, causing assets to be reallocated among different wallets. There aren’t many historical references to similar events, but the 2017 Ledger malicious firmware incident did briefly rattle the market. The significance of the comparison here is that, in the future, hardware wallets may no longer be as simple as “buy a device and you’re done.” Instead, users will need to choose differently based on asset types and usage scenarios.

以太坊市场深度分析：两千七百美元攻防战与生态扩张下的价值重估

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月一日上午，以太坊当前报价二千六百八十六点九二美元，过去二十四小时微涨百分之零点五七。价格在前一时段冲高至二千七百三十一美元后遭遇明显抛压，随后快速回落至二千六百八十七美元附近整理。从小时K线来看，最近五个交易时段以太坊在二千六百八十四美元至二千六百九十四美元之间窄幅波动，成交量呈现先放大后缩小的特征，显示多空双方在关键阻力位附近分歧加大。

从均线系统观察，以太坊当前价格已站上七小时均线二千六百八十六点八六和二十五小时均线二千六百八十五点一零，同时紧贴九十九小时均线二千六百八十五点九一。短期均线呈现多头粘合态势，价格运行在三条均线的交汇处，方向选择迫在眉睫。布林带中轨位于二千六百八十八点七零，上轨二千七百一十四点九六，下轨二千六百六十二点四四，通道宽度适中，价格在中轨附近震荡。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标出现积极变化，最新MACD值为零点二六，信号线从零下区域回升至负零点零四，柱状图由负转正并扩大至零点三零，形成底部金叉后的持续放量形态，短期动能正在由空转多。RSI六周期指标回升至五十四点三五，重回中性偏多区域，十四周期RSI位于五十一以上，二十四周期RSI维持在五十上方，三线共振显示市场情绪正在改善。

KDJ指标表现强劲，K值从三十九快速拉升至六十六点零五，D值升至五十四点一四，J值更是达到八十九点八六，三线呈多头排列向上发散，短期上涨动能充沛。威廉指标WR从零下七十二点七六大幅改善至负五十四点四一，脱离超卖区域，确认了反弹趋势的有效性。

从波动率角度看，十四周期ATR从十七点四三下降至十五点零九，波动性持续收敛。标准差维持在一点八二左右的低位水平，显示市场处于低波动盘整状态。抛物线转向指标SAR位于二千七百一十四点五五，仍对价格形成上方压力，需要有效突破才能确认趋势反转。

量化因子方面，十五个因子中看多因子六个，看空因子八个，中性因子一个。复合指标发出看空信号，但整体胜率达到百分之六十五点九六，其中做多信号的历史胜率高达百分之七十点五九，说明当前虽然短期偏空，但一旦出现做多信号，其可靠性较高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊近期最大的利好来自机构生态的持续扩张。多家支付巨头联合推出了跨网络Open USD稳定币方案，注入十亿美元流动性支持，进一步巩固了以太坊在去中心化金融领域的核心地位。Robinhood宣布上线以太坊永续合约产品，为散户投资者提供了更多参与渠道，也标志着传统金融对以太坊生态的认可度持续提升。

然而链上出现了一些值得关注的风险信号。一位早期参与者将十三万三千二百九十八枚以太坊（价值超过三点五六亿美元）转移至新地址，市场担忧这部分筹码若流入交易所将引发大规模抛售。与此同时，以太坊现货ETF在连续七天净流入后出现反转，九月三十日录得五千九百六十万美元的净流出，结束了此前的资金涌入态势。

从技术面来看，以太坊在触及二千七百三十一美元时小时级别RSI一度飙升至八十四点七六，进入严重超买区域，随后触发了快速的均值回归。这一走势说明短期内上方抛压较重，多头需要更多利好催化才能有效突破。

宏观环境对以太坊形成双重影响。美国核心PCE数据低于预期缓解了加息压力，有利于风险资产估值修复。但机构资金在比特币和以太坊之间的分配比例仍然悬殊，上周数字资产投资产品中比特币吸纳了二十五点二亿美元，以太坊获得的份额相对有限。

综合来看，以太坊正处于技术面改善与链上风险并存的复杂局面。MACD金叉和KDJ多头排列为短期反弹提供了技术支撑，但鲸鱼转账和ETF流出构成了潜在的供给压力。投资者应重点关注二千七百美元关口的攻防情况，以及链上大额转账的后续动向。

translatedData.content:
ETH enters a six-hour search surge｜Attention isn’t the same as net fund buying｜Around 2687 I wait for relative strength confirmation

My stance is to observe—not to chase more just because the words “Rapid Riser” appear. On Binance’s latest Most Searched (six-hour) page, ETH has been labeled a Rapid Riser. That means search interest is rising, but it does not mean order quantity, on-chain activity, or institutional holdings are increasing in sync. The Trending Topics alongside it are mainly still BTC breakout, employment, PCE, and other topics. The page does not provide a conclusion that “ETH has received new capital inflows.” Treating the search leaderboard as a proxy for capital flows is a common mistake in trading interpretation.

I also verify the evidence of funds separately. In Farside’s September 30 Ethereum fund table, the data already shows Fidelity FETH outflows of $26.6 million, Grayscale ETHE outflows of $7.5 million, and Grayscale mini ETH outflows of $25.5 million; but BlackRock’s ETHA, ETHB, and some other products are still blank bars with no report yet. The table’s automatic total of negative $59.6 million is merely the subtotal of reported entries—not the final net flow for the entire market, nor proof that ETH was sold for $59.6 million intraday today. The net outflow of $2.8 million on September 29 is another trading day, and you also can’t simply add the two arbitrary day-ends and claim “two consecutive days of confirmation.” Independent sources, aligned time windows, and matching trading units must be consistent.

What has the market itself done? At the time of writing, Binance ETH/USDT is about $2687.22, up roughly 0.392% over the past 24 hours; the range is 2656.92 to 2738.51. ETH/BTC is about 0.03218, up roughly 0.312% over the past 24 hours. This indicates that within the same 24-hour window ETH has some relative strength versus BTC, but it still hasn’t broken above the intraday upper boundary. You can’t call this a full rotation of capital. Increased search heat may lead to more short-term orders, or it may simply reflect investors checking reasons for the dip. Only when price, relative strength, and subsequent fund-flow data move in the same direction is it more worth increasing confidence.

My view would be overturned in two scenarios: (1) If ETH/USDT effectively holds above 2740 and ETH/BTC continues to defend above 0.0322, and meanwhile the remaining fund entries report stronger inflows, then I would admit the buy pressure is more solid than what we see right now; (2) If it breaks below 2656 and ETH/BTC falls back below 0.0320, then the so-called “rapid rise” is only search interest, and the price didn’t catch up. In either case, you can’t fill in blanks (unreported bars) as zeros, nor can you replace actual trades with hot-search rankings.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate. The only direction I consider is low-risk spot longs with zero leverage and small position sizing. I would only use up to 0.25% of total capital for a trial trade if ETH/USDT reclaims 2705 and does not break through 2695 on the retest, with ETH/BTC also not falling below 0.0322. First target: 2738—when it hits the halving level, I reduce half. Second target: 2765—reduce the remaining position. After entry, if it breaks below 2672, I stop out immediately. If it breaks below 2656 first, I cancel the plan and wait in cash. Even after entering, if within one hour it closes back below 2705 again or if newly reported fund data and price both turn weaker, I will proactively close the position rather than letting it drag into the next day. These are future conditions, not records of completed trades or realized profit.

Data cross-check: Binance Plaza Most Searched (six-hour) leaderboard, Farside Ethereum fund daily table, and the live quotes of Binance ETH/USDT and ETH/BTC. #ETH
The above is only personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH进入六小时搜索快速上升｜关注度不等于基金净买盘｜2687附近我等相对强度确认

我的态度是观察，不因为“Rapid Riser”四个字立即追多。币安广场最新Most Searched（六小时）页面把ETH标成Rapid Riser，这说明搜索关注在抬升，不代表买单数量、链上活跃或机构持仓同步增长。与它并列的Trending Topics主要仍是BTC突破、就业、PCE等话题，页面没有给出“ETH已获新资金流入”的结论。把搜索榜当成资金流表，是交易中常见的口径错误。

我把资金证据另拿出来核对。Farside的9月30日以太坊基金表，目前已显示富达FETH流出2660万美元、灰度ETHE流出750万美元、灰度迷你ETH流出2550万美元；但贝莱德ETHA、ETHB以及部分其他产品仍是横杠未报。表内自动合计负5960万美元只是已报栏位的阶段值，不是全市场最终净流，更不是今天盘中ETH被卖出5960万美元的证据。9月29日的净流出280万美元是另一个交易日，也不能与30日任意相加后宣称“连续两日确认”。独立来源、时间窗和交易单位必须对齐。

市场本身已有怎样的反应？写稿时币安ETH/USDT约2687.22美元，过去24小时涨约0.392%，区间2656.92至2738.51；ETH/BTC约0.03218，过去24小时涨约0.312%。这表示同一个24小时窗口里ETH对BTC暂有一点相对强度，却仍没有突破日内上沿，不能把它说成全面资金轮动。搜索热度增加可能让短线订单更密集，也可能只是投资者在查下跌原因；只有价格、相对强弱与后续资金数据同向，才更值得提高把握。

我的判断被推翻有两种情形：若ETH/USDT有效站上2740且ETH/BTC持续守住0.0322上方，同时基金余下栏位补报转强，我会承认买盘比现在看到的更扎实；若跌破2656并且ETH/BTC退回0.0320下方，则所谓“快速上升”只是搜索关注，价格没有跟上。无论哪边，都不能拿未更新的横杠填成零或拿热搜替代成交。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑零杠杆现货轻仓多头。只有ETH/USDT重新站上2705且回踩不破2695、ETH/BTC同步不低于0.0322，我才用总资金最多0.25%试单；第一目标2738，触及减半，第二目标2765再减剩余仓位。入场后跌破2672立即止损；如先跌穿2656则取消计划，空仓等待。即便已入场，若一小时内再次收回2705下方或新增基金补报与价格一同转弱，也主动平仓，不拖到第二天。这些都是未来条件，不是已成交或获利记录。

数据核对：币安广场Most Searched六小时榜、Farside以太坊基金逐日表、币安ETH/USDT与ETH/BTC实时报价。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月一日凌晨，以太坊报价二千六百八十六点九二美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点四八。盘中价格一度受大额买盘推动冲高至二千七百三十一点零零美元，但随后遭遇上方卖墙压制，回落至二千六百八十五美元附近整理。从日线结构来看，以太坊在重新站上二千七百美元关口后未能有效维持，RSI在触及八十四点七的超买区域后快速回落，价格在上轨布林带二千七百三十九美元附近遭到明确的技术性拒绝。当前价格运行在短期均线系统之中，二千七百美元整数位由支撑转为阻力，若后续无法有效突破，则可能回测二千六百公里下方的支撑区域。

二、技术指标解读

从因子统计来看，十五个技术因子中有六个发出做多信号，八个发出做空信号，一个保持中性，空头因子占比达到百分之五十三点三，整体偏空。综合指标数值为负零点五九，信号指向做空，历史胜率约为百分之六十三点三三。具体来看，五周期均线因子是少数维持做多的指标之一，显示极短期价格仍有支撑。但alpha1、alpha7、alpha11、alpha17等多个因子均发出明确的空头信号，其中alpha7的原始值达到负一，为最强烈的看空信号之一。RSI十四周期因子维持中性，表明当前既非超买也非超卖，市场处于方向选择的临界点。值得关注的积极信号是，alpha29和alpha23等因子仍维持做多，且做多信号的历史胜率约为百分之七十点五九，高于做空信号的百分之六十三点三三，说明一旦多头信号被触发，其可靠性相对更高。

以太坊当前的市场情绪受到两股力量的拉扯。积极方面，Robinhood宣布推出永续期货合约，加之Stripe旗下的Bridge发行的Open USD稳定币正式部署在以太坊网络上，通过Mastercard、Stripe和Visa等平台向企业用户开放，这些生态层面的扩展为以太坊带来了实质性的需求支撑。此外，链上出现单笔三千七百五十万美元的净大额买入，显示有机构级别资金在积极建仓。然而消极因素同样不容忽视，以太坊现货ETF连续两日出现资金净流出，九月二十九日流出二百八十万美元，九月三十日流出高达五千九百六十万美元，结束了此前的持续积累阶段。这与比特币ETF的强劲流入形成鲜明对比，表明机构资金在当前阶段更倾向于配置比特币而非以太坊。短期来看，以太坊需要在二千六百五十美元至二千七百美元区间内完成充分的筹码交换，才能为下一次突破积蓄动能。

translatedData.content:
When BTC is range-bound at 83K, the most expensive part is realizing after the trade that the order book changed

BTC spent the whole night grinding around 83K. Many people will focus on whether they should “chase,” but I think this segment is more about order quality.

A range-bound market doesn’t mean a good fill. Even if the price looks unchanged, the quote layer may already have switched to another group of people: the thickness in the first couple of levels gets thinner, the spread is gradually widened, and once you plug in your target quantity, you end up consuming the next few layers. When you replay the chart, you’re looking at the same candlestick—but the real execution leaves a different kind of fill distortion.

Before I place an order, I ask three questions:
1) This amount—what quote level does it actually reach?
2) After entering, if you need to unwind in the opposite direction, is the liquidity still there?
3) For the same asset but a different route, are the spread, depth, and trigger conditions clearly different?

Direction judgment only determines whether you want to trade. The trading environment is what determines whether this order feels good to execute. PerpEX-style execution-focused value isn’t there to tell you which direction to take—it’s to remind you: compare the order quality across different venues first, then decide where to route this order.

#BTC #ETH

content:
83K横盘时，最贵的是成交后才发现盘口变了

BTC在83K附近磨了一晚上，很多人会把注意力放在“要不要追”上，但我觉得这一段更该看订单质量。

横盘不代表好成交。价格看着没动，报价层可能已经换了一批人：前两档厚度变薄，点差被慢慢拉开，目标数量一打进去就吃到后面几层。你复盘时看到的是同一根K线，真实账单里留下的是另一种成交偏差。

我现在下单前会先问三个问题：这一笔数量吃到第几层报价？进去之后，如果要反向处理，承接还在不在？同一资产换一条路径，点差、深度和触发条件是不是明显不一样？

方向判断只能决定你想不想做，订单环境才决定这一单做得舒不舒服。PerpEX这类执行比较视角的价值，不是替你判断方向，而是提醒你：先比较不同venue的订单质量，再决定这一单往哪走。

ETF outflows have widened｜Fidelity FETH adds -$26.60 million｜Around 2692 I still won’t chase

My stance is clear first: this isn’t a conclusion that “all-market capital has ultimately withdrawn.” However, the additional line is enough to raise the threshold for me to chase longs in the short term. In Farside’s table of U.S. spot Ethereum ETF flows, as of September 30 Fidelity’s FETH reported a net outflow of $26.60 million. Grayscale ETHE outflowed $7.50 million, and Grayscale’s mini ETH product outflowed $25.50 million. The automated total for filled entries expanded from the -$33 million I observed this morning to -$59.60 million. Note: this refers to estimated USD subscriptions/redemptions, not the amount of ETH sold on-chain immediately.

In the table, BlackRock’s ETHA, ETHB, etc. still show dashes. Dashes mean the numbers have not been reported yet—they do not equal zero. Therefore, you can’t write -$59.60 million as the day’s complete net flow, nor use it to predict next trading day’s price.

Why is this update worth watching? Previously, only two Grayscale products reported negative numbers. Now the Fidelity line is added, so the outflow source is no longer only concentrated in Grayscale. If later large products also turn negative, the view that institutional demand is weakening at the margin becomes more solid. Conversely, if later a large inflow offsets the current negative figures, today’s relatively cautious funding signal will be overturned. What I care about is the direction and continuity of the full table, not slapping an “institutional selling” label on ETH based on a table that hasn’t been fully filled.

Fund creations/redemptions are also affected by creation/redemption timing, inventory, and settlement schedules, and therefore can’t be perfectly mapped to Binance spot trading at minute-level granularity.

The market isn’t falling one-sided on this set of partial data. At the time of writing, Binance ETH/USDT is around 2692, up about 0.61% over 24 hours, with a range from 2656.92 to 2738.51. Price is still holding above this morning’s level, which suggests the spot order book and the yet-to-be completed ETF table are currently sending different signals. I won’t be arbitrary about who is driving the rise, and I also won’t short against the trend just because some outflows appear.

For the short term, I’ll first watch whether 2680 to 2690 can be repeatedly defended, then whether there is sustained volume between 2705 and 2720. Around 2738 is the high of the past 24 hours—it's not a confirmed breakout.

The real “alpha” in this cycle isn’t Bitcoin—it’s Ethereum.

Bitcoin’s regulatory compliance is a double-edged sword. As the U.S. regulatory framework gradually became clearer, institutions did start allocating to BTC. But once that allocation is done, it’s done—after the ETF approval, the money that was supposed to come in has already come in. Spot holdings’ cost basis is concentrated above 80,000, so subsequent marginal buy pressure keeps diminishing. More importantly, compliance essentially locks BTC into its “digital gold” role. It no longer has room for narrative upgrades; it can only earn the beta from macro liquidity. A valuation adjustment to $100,000 is reasonable, but expecting it to run another 5x or 10x super-cycle is extremely unlikely.

The industry ecosystem is exhausting the crypto market’s credibility. Scam projects, rug pulls, Meme coins zero-sum games and harvesting… these tumors are permanently shutting the door on potential new users. As an industry benchmark, Bitcoin will inevitably suffer from the broader fallout—without new capital entering, competition among existing participants will only become more and more inwardly intense.

Ethereum is the true narrative engine for the next bull cycle.

In the past three years, it has done something extremely important that the market hasn’t fully priced in yet: without sacrificing decentralization, it has basically solved the throughput and cost problems through Layer 2. The combined daily active usage across L2 networks like Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism is already far beyond that of the mainnet. On-chain finance, tokenization of RWA assets, prediction markets, decentralized stablecoins… these aren’t just fantasies—they’re real businesses that are already running.

Ethereum doesn’t lack technology—it lacks the emotional ignition point. Once RWA or some niche segment of on-chain finance explodes, ETH, as the underlying settlement layer and the gas consumption layer, will simultaneously capture the dual premium of “practical value reappraisal + network effect virtuous cycle.” Its market cap is only one-third of Bitcoin’s, so its upside elasticity is far greater than its downside room.

Conclusion: Bitcoin is a defensive allocation; Ethereum is an offensive position. If I can only bet on one in this cycle, I choose ETH.

The early session didn’t surge much—the easiest thing to misjudge is the depth

BTC is still trading around $83,000 and grinding sideways. ETH follows with only a slight move, while SOL is actually weaker. In a market like this, it’s easiest to let your guard down: since the price doesn’t look like it’s gone anywhere, traders tend to assume the order book is still solid too.

But the most insidious kind of cost in contracts is often hidden in this “nothing’s moving.”

For the same order, whether the first few bid/ask layers are still there, whether your target quantity will be filled further back, whether the spread quietly widens, and whether the liquidity on exit is just as thin—all of these can make the execution result feel different from what the chart seems to show. Direction only determines whether you decide to trade; order quality determines whether this trade is dragged down by costs from the very beginning.

Right now, I’m more inclined to treat the 10 seconds before placing an order as part of risk control: first check the quote layers, then check the depth, then review any fill slippage and the trigger rules. The real value of execution-focused platforms like PerpEX isn’t that they help you judge direction—it’s that they remind you not to stare only at the price, but to also see the environment this specific order will actually go through.

#BTC #ETH

Long-term Bitcoin holders have started breaking even and returning to profit—this suggests the market may have already bottomed out. These veterans (typically holders who have had BTC for more than two years) were stuck in a loss zone before, but they’ve finally turned profitable. Their breaking even can boost market sentiment, but it also mainly reflects the resilience of the “main players,” hinting that this correction isn’t the end of the bull market—more like a mid-cycle pause.

Why is this news important?
There are two reasons. First, Bitcoin’s halving cycle often encourages long-time holders with lower cost bases to begin realizing profits. But this time, they didn’t cash out at high prices—instead, they chose to keep holding, which signals recognition of the current price. Second, long-term holders returning to break-even means the market’s panic sentiment (the mildly underwater range) has largely been digested. This is an important indicator of the market shifting from excessive selling toward stability. In the current cycle, that likely means Bitcoin is in a safer zone rather than the final frenzy before a collapse.

Impact on the market
For BTC, this is at least a short-term sentiment catalyst: when veterans break even, it can attract more follow-the-crowd demand. More importantly, it confirms the “mid-cycle bottoming characteristics” for Bitcoin. Historically, after the first wave of price movement following a halving, there is often a bottom-building process driven by veterans returning to break-even. This suggests that around $84K may not be the final stop. However, if it can hold, the chance of a rebound to $95K (assuming this upside matches the halving-driven historical pattern) becomes significantly higher. 长期持有比特币的人开始回本盈利了，这事儿意味着市场可能触底了。这些老手（通常指持币超过两年的）之前一直被套在亏损区，现在终于扭亏为盈。他们回本对市场情绪有提振作用，但更多是显示主力的韧性，暗示这轮调整不是牛市的终点，更像是中期休整。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这背后是两个原因：一是比特币的减半周期通常能刺激持有成本降低的老手开始变现，但这次他们没在高位走人，反而选择了继续持有，显示了对当前价格认可的信号。二是长期持有者回本意味着市场的恐慌情绪（浅套区）基本消化了，这是市场从过度抛售转向稳定性的重要指标。在当前周期，这意味着比特币大概率处于一个更安全的区域，而不是崩盘前的最后疯狂。

对市场的影响

📰 Why is KakaoPay doing tokenized equities? How much room does internationalization for the Korean stock market really have?

KakaoPay Securities, South Korea’s largest payments platform, plans to tokenize listed stocks, essentially giving foreign investors a green light. Simply put, it would let global investors buy Korean stocks the way they buy cryptocurrencies. But South Korea’s stock market still has a relatively high barrier right now—you need local identity. If this move works, it would be like turning the Korean stock market from an “internal club” into an “international open market,” potentially attracting a wave of global capital.

Why is this news important?
KakaoPay’s move isn’t just riding crypto momentum—there are three deep underlying logics. First, South Korea is one of the most active markets for global crypto trading. The trend of domestic funds moving to overseas exchanges has already taken hold, so serving this demand with a localized platform is inevitable. Second, international investors have long complained that opening brokerage accounts in Korea is too cumbersome and that currency conversion costs are high—tokenization can perfectly address these pain points. Third, this is essentially a bet that global asset allocation will spread from a single “coin circle” into a hybrid ecosystem. If it succeeds, it could reshape the digital path for cross-border assets.

Market impact
In the short term, it may boost ETH, since tokenization is fundamentally a form of digital financial innovation, which would increase demand for the underlying infrastructure. For the likely transmission path: South Korea is one of the most active crypto trading markets globally—domestic funds moving out → selling pressure on BTC. In the long run, if it successfully attracts institutional funds, it could indirectly support BTC prices. But note that currently, BNB Chain and Solana are the top players in the tokenization track, so KakaoPay faces significant competitive pressure.

💡 My take: this is neutral-to-positive for ETH. The main thing to watch is how fast KakaoPay can execute. If they can launch a platform meeting international standards within three months, ETH could test the $2,800 resistance level in the short term. The failure condition is: if Korean regulators suddenly tighten rules around cross-border capital flows, this logic falls apart.

韩国最大的支付平台KakaoPay Securities要搞上市股票的代币化，专门给外国人开绿灯。简单说，就是让全球投资客能像买加密币一样买韩国股票，而韩国股市现在门槛还挺高，必须当地身份。这步棋如果成，等于把韩国股市从"内部俱乐部"变成"国际开放市"，可能吸引全球资金涌入。

为什么这条新闻重要？
KakaoPay这次行动不是简单蹭加密热，背后有三大深层逻辑。第一，韩国是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金抽离到海外交易所已成趋势，本地化平台直接服务这部分需求是必然。第二，国际投资者一直抱怨韩国股票开户太麻烦，货币兑换成本高，代币化能完美解决这些痛点。第三，这其实是在赌全球资产配置会从单一币圈蔓延到混合圈，如果成功，会重塑跨境资产数字化路径。

对市场的影响
短期内可能提振ETH，因为代币化本质是数字化金融创新，会带动对底层基础设施的需求。具体传导路径看，韩国是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金抽离→BTC抛压。长期看，如果成功吸引机构资金，可能会间接支撑BTC价格。但要注意，目前BNB Chain和Solana才是代币化赛道头部玩家，KakaoPay的竞争压力不小。

💡 我看这波是中性偏利好ETH，主要看KakaoPay的落地速度。如果他们能在三个月内推出符合国际标准的平台，ETH短期可能测试$2,800阻力位。但失效条件是：如果韩国监管突然收紧跨境资金流动，这个逻辑就作废了。

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTC and ETH could see volatility due to risk-off sentiment. But a more likely scenario is that the U.S. and Iran continue trading blows via proxies, and oil prices will keep tugging back and forth in the $118.98–$118.98 range. Despite this, the South Korean government still plans to implement the tax on income from crypto assets according to the original schedule.

Why this news matters?
South Korea is a major jurisdiction for cryptocurrency regulation worldwide, and changes in its policies directly affect global market sentiment. Because a regulatory gap before taxation would create uncertainty for the market, while a clear legal framework can reduce that uncertainty. This suggests that the South Korean government may be waiting for a more complete regulatory system to govern the crypto asset market—especially the overseas exchange segment. In the short term, it also implies that South Korea's crypto market tax environment is unlikely to change significantly, at least not to be more aggressive than originally planned.

Impact on the market

This proposal indicates that the market may not need to worry too much about harsh tax policy in the short term; however, in the long run, tax issues will still be addressed gradually as the legal framework is refined.
